satellites.title: The Three Doors of Action
satellites.evidence: Buddhist analyses distinguish action of body, speech and mind. 意 marks the mental domain, not an assertion that every thought is morally equivalent to an action.

satellites.title: Mind, the Sixth Sense-Base
satellites.evidence: In Buddhist translation 意 renders manas, the mind counted as a sixth faculty beside eye, ear, nose, tongue and body. The Heart Sutra runs the list as 無眼耳鼻舌身意, “no eye, ear, nose, tongue, body, mind”.
satellites.caveat: Everyday 意 is intention or meaning; the faculty is a technical Buddhist sense of the same graph.

checked.note: 是故空中無色，無受想行識，無眼耳鼻舌身意
